caption: The drawing depicts a spacious, well-organized stable interior with brown wooden stalls and ornate partitioning on the left side, where grooming tools such as brushes, pitchforks, brooms, and a shovel hang neatly on the wall. Below these, a green bench is placed, holding saddles and tack. The floor is a patterned reddish-brown tile, with a long beige and green carpet runner down the center. In the middle of the floor, there is a small wooden cart with a metal scoop resting inside, alongside a wooden pail. To the right, three labeled wooden buckets sit atop a black metal stand. The back wall features large double wooden doors with decorative arched glass panes, framed by light blue-gray brick walls. Several vertical windows with green glass dot the upper portion of the walls. Above, exposed wooden roof beams are visible, and a brass chandelier with glass globes hangs from the ceiling. Set to the right are more wall-mounted storage fixtures: a brass bell, several racks holding horse bridles and harnesses, folded green blankets, and a sign labeled "Halter Strap." The overall color palette features browns, greens, golds, and muted blues.
title: Stable
